- SE feedback (Priya): current 8-hour run under-delivered by ~40% against projected tokens/sec when using their tokenization pipeline and long context (up to 2k tokens). Causes: suboptimal batching and cold KV-cache hits.

Also propose an autoscale buffer for 15% burst headroom - but Pinegrove wants hard concurrency caps instead of autoscale for cost predictability.
- Pricing: AE proposed committed reserved pool pricing for 4xH100 (monthly commit) vs 8xA10G (cheaper ops). Finance prefers H100 for predictability on latency-sensitive tasks.
- Customer quote: "If tail latency spikes, our customer contracts break — we need guarantees, not best-effort."
- Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO (SAML), KMS integration; EU residency for EU-origin data.
- Next tactical: agree SLA language this week, then run 72h continuous throughput verification in dedicated pool with instrumentation (tracing + token-level cost). If passes, legal to approve credit terms; aim to close by 2026-06.
